entries.origin_analysis: P2/P3 losses remained untreated after Family C, while absolute-adverse and recovery-timing rules in D/E were not sufficient. Family G tested whether return inside the original breakout level was a more structural invalidation signal.
entries.causal_hypothesis: An F05 position whose executable price returns inside its original breakout reference level at a frozen checkpoint has structurally failed and should be closed.
pre_result_predictions: at least one cell is positive in 2023 and both 2024 halves
entries.decision: Close Family G before MT4 parity or 2025 access.

State-adaptive checkpoint timing resolves the cross-period sign reversal
retained_findings: Winner harm is approximately as large as benefit
